LanguageData.OA_LetterResearchSummit_AcademicDispute:
In this research summit, two groups of scholars from different factions had a heated argument over the two possibilities of a topic. When your attendees curiously gather to watch, their conflicts have escalated from simple academic conflicts to factional friction, intensifying to irreconcilable levels.
In order to ease the conflict and atmosphere of the summit, the attendants of Oberonia Aurea forcefully intervened in the argument between the two sides and calmed them down, hoping to use other relatively mild means to resolve the conflict between them. However, this idea was firmly rejected by the two sides who had become angry during the argument, and almost caused another conflict.

Finally, with the mediation and intervention of Oberonia Aurea, the attendees of both sides agreed to hold a non life-threatening fight at the end of the summit to vent their dissatisfaction with each other and undermine their confidence. 
Your attendees have obtained the agreed location for this fight from the attendants present. If you go to observe, it will give everyone a certain level of combat experience.
LanguageData.OA_LetterVisit_RSAcademicDispute:
Although both sides had sufficient fire and put in extra effort during the fight, due to the fact that most of the attendees were inexperienced researchers and the attendants of Oberonia Aurea were always on the side to control order and prevent the scene from getting out of control, this ritualistic fight ultimately became as unprofessional as street fights. 
As the researchers from both sides of the expedition covered their heads and cursed as they exited, each member of the expedition team gained {0} points of combat experience. In addition, after everyone had left, your expedition team found a money bag belonging to an unknown unlucky person in the nearby grass, and easily took it into their pocket.

LanguageData.OA_LetterResearchSummit_EccentricScholar: After the scientific summit, on the way out, your attendees found a scholar worrying about a pile of waste. Perhaps you can go ask him what he wants to do and give him a little help.
LanguageData.OA_ResearchSummit_EccentricScholarText:
As you gradually approached, you could hear the scholar muttering incessantly, such as' stupid people who don't understand science 'and' they are the waste 

After a brief exchange, you barely understood the situation from the scholar's endless complaints - for this scientific research summit, the scholar packed all the equipment in his laboratory and hoped that they could shine at the summit and impress other scholars.

However, things never went as planned. The equipment of this scholar not only failed to impress other scholars, but was also referred to as "waste" by them. Even passing transport trucks expressed that "waste is not within the scope of transportation". In the end, this scholar could only stand by the roadside and watch the pile of things worry.


If you can help him move this pile of experimental equipment to his temporary residence, then you will receive the gratitude of this scholar and the compensation he has prepared for you. \If he is really prepared.

LanguageData.OA_ResearchSummit_EccentricScholarFinish:
After putting in a lot of effort, your {0} finally moved those strange shaped devices to the scholar's temporary residence. And in order to express his gratitude to you, this scholar spent three to four hours introducing the functions of these machines to you. If it weren't for your {0} taking advantage of his inattention and gradually moving to the door and eventually snatching it away, it can be imagined that this scholar would have been talking non-stop.

In addition, although your {0} was very careful, a considerable number of devices that seemed to be on the verge of falling apart unexpectedly ended up falling apart. And while the scholar was grieving, your {0} quietly picked up some of the seemingly useful parts and successfully put them into your waist bag. 

Obtain: {1} components, {2} steel, and all participants gain {3} points of intellectual experience.
LanguageData.OA_ResearchSummit_EccentricScholarLeaveH: Your {0} quietly left halfway through. The scholar may continue to have a headache.
LanguageData.OA_LetterResearchSummit_MysteriousTrader: At the end of the summit, you noticed a plainly dressed person mysteriously selling something to passersby, and in the blink of an eye he had already walked away. Perhaps you can ask him what he is selling.
LanguageData.OA_ResearchSummit_MysteriousTrader:
When your caravan approached this mysterious guy, before you could speak, the mysterious seller couldn't wait to start selling the few books in his backpack to you.

"You don't know, these books of mine are quite precious, and only those with a connection can obtain them. It is said that after the previous owner of these books obtained them, he immediately rose to prosperity, and I was fortunate enough to acquire them. Let me tell you, if I weren't a bit short of money now, I wouldn't sell these books to others!......"

Although the person in front of you is boasting about his books, whenever you want to check the contents first, he immediately puts the books behind his back and says that you can only read them after buying them.

His greedy eyes are staring at your wallet.
